faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KGMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KGMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for KGMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of the Professor & Head, Department of Biochemistry, King George's Medical University UP, Lucknow, by by post or by hand, to reach by 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years (as on 1st of April of the year in which the application is made).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 25,000 per month for the first 2 years and Rs. 28,000 per month for the 3rd year.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Sc. (Ag.), M.Sc., M. Pharm., M.V.Sc., B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent degree; first division in Graduation and Post-Graduation; only Indian citizens resident of Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian citizens who are resident of Uttar Pradesh are eligible for Research Asstt ships/Associate ships in research projects funded by CST UP.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who are not residents of Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. No separate call letters will be sent for the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Project duration: three years. Employment for one year, extendable for another two years based on performance and recommendation of the Principal Investigator.
